profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
As a software engineer, I have developed and deployed cloud-based applications using Terraform and Ruby on Rails, working with agile methodologies and best practices. I have also obtained the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner certification, demonstrating my knowledge and skills in cloud computing.

I graduated from Iowa State University with a bachelor's degree in software engineering. I am passionate about creating innovative and scalable solutions that solve real-world problems and enhance user experience. I am looking for new opportunities to leverage my software engineering skills and learn new technologies.

positions.description: Skills: API Development · .NET Framework · C# · User Interface Design · Semantic Kernel · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · OpenAi

positions.description: Skills: Microservices · Ruby on Rails · Agile Methodologies · API Development · Terraform · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.description: Skills: Microservices · Ruby on Rails · API Development · Terraform · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Software Intern
positions.description:
- Fixed a defect that existed in an internal website search tool that created inconvenience and
incorrect results for users
- Amended scripts to help and ensure creation of new databases within existing zones
- Configured and helped decouple database data by migrating data from an existing database into a newly created one

positions.title: CSAFE Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Assisted with research to build a software that can match bullets in a crime scene with a database
- Collected 3D bullet images using a specialized camera
- Assigned appropriate ID’s to bullet casings

positions.title: Software Intern
positions.description:
- Worked with Ruby on Rails to develop a new filter feature for server clients within a Cerner
internal web application
- Generated ‘add’ and ‘delete’ webpage forms and functionalities to give users more abilities within
the web application
- Tested the web application with RSpec, a Ruby on Rails popular testing tool

positions.title: System Intern
positions.description:
- Developed Python script that automated extraction of users and their privileges information from
a database and generated a JSON file based on the information
- Re-engineered team’s popular Korn Shell program using Python to be more efficient,
understandable, and editable
- Created PowerShell script that automated the extraction of critical information of Windows
Servers and generated a JSON file based on the information

positions.title: Computer Science Teacher Assistant
positions.description:
- Assisted teaching students in an ‘Introduction to Object-Oriented’ course
- Managed a lab session of about 40 students
- Hosted office hours and aided students with any questions related to the course
- Proctored exam sessions

positions.title: CSAFE Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Assisted with research to build a software that can match bullets in a crime scene with a database
- Collected 3D bullet images using a specialized camera
- Assigned appropriate ID’s to bullet casings

positions.title: MCAD/PLM Systems Support Co-op
positions.description:
- Aided in managing company’s database
- Implemented technical solutions for other MCAD users
- Developed CAD files that users had difficulty creating in the database
- Supervised users to make sure they were following Global Engineering Standards

honors.title: COM S 309 Best Manager Award
honors.description: In the 200+ classroom size course, COM S 309 Software Engineering Practices, I was one of the five individuals to be awarded 'Best Manager'. The objective of the course was to give students experience in building and managing a full project from scratch within the semester. I worked on front-end android development for a project called Lab Assistant.

honors.title: Science Bound Scholarship
honors.description: The tuition-paid scholarship is awarded to students who completed the four-year Science Bound program in high school and excel in Science Technology Engineering and Mathematics.
